additional_info.body:
Dear Szymon.
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and regarding your questions.
We are only able to change the OCPP router configuration from our backend system remotely.
As the client is using an external system, we are not able to change or adapt anything else regarding the configuration from our end. This should be discussed with the provider of their own backend system.
We hope to have informed you enough. Please provide us with feedback if this answered your question.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
